scripts.build: rslib build -c rsbuild.config.mts && bun run build:types
scripts.lint: bun run generate:version && eslint src test
scripts.test: bun run generate:version && bun test test/gen-utils.test.ts test/issues.test.ts test/audit-fixes.test.ts test/pptxgen.e2e.test.ts test/contracts.test.ts test/coverage.test.ts test/coverage-objects.test.ts test/package-version-plugin.test.ts test/ms-pptx-profile.test.ts test/pptx-verify.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: bun run generate:version && bun test --coverage test/gen-utils.test.ts test/issues.test.ts test/audit-fixes.test.ts test/pptxgen.e2e.test.ts test/contracts.test.ts test/coverage.test.ts test/coverage-objects.test.ts test/package-version-plugin.test.ts test/ms-pptx-profile.test.ts test/pptx-verify.test.ts
scripts.test:office: bun run generate:version && bun test test/office-open.test.ts
scripts.test:powerpoint: bun run generate:version && bun test --timeout 180000 --max-concurrency 1 test/powerpoint-open.test.ts && bun test --timeout 180000 --max-concurrency 1 test/powerpoint-repair-fixtures.test.ts
scripts.test:jsx: bun run --cwd packages/pptxgenjs-jsx typecheck && bun test packages/pptxgenjs-jsx
scripts.test:std: bun run --cwd packages/pptxgenjs-std typecheck && bun test packages/pptxgenjs-std
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:jsx && bun run test:std
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run check && bun run build
